# Cheap Stays

> A calmer way to compare stays. Search hotels, apartments, and vacation rentals in one place and book through travel sites you already know.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.cheap-stays.com/): Hotel and stay search
- [Español](https://www.cheap-stays.com/es): Spanish home page
- [Português (Brasil)](https://www.cheap-stays.com/br): Brazilian Portuguese home page
- [About](https://www.cheap-stays.com/about): About Cheap Stays
- [Contact](https://www.cheap-stays.com/contact): Contact and support
- [Privacy](https://www.cheap-stays.com/privacy): Privacy policy

## Sitelink guides

- [Last Minute Hotel Deals](https://www.cheap-stays.com/last-minute-hotel-deals): Compare last-minute hotel deals for tonight. Search any city, review what’s listed right now, and continue to book only if a stay looks right.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.cheap-stays.com/last-minute-hotel-deals.md
- [Unsold Room Deals](https://www.cheap-stays.com/unsold-room-deals): Compare unsold hotel room deals and late availability. Search tonight’s dates, see what is still listed, and review terms before you book.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.cheap-stays.com/unsold-room-deals.md
- [Hotels Under $100](https://www.cheap-stays.com/hotels-under-100): Compare budget hotels and affordable stays by city. Rates vary with dates and destination — sort the results by price to see lower options.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.cheap-stays.com/hotels-under-100.md
- [60% Off Hotel Deals](https://www.cheap-stays.com/60-off-hotel-deals): Compare hotel deals and promotional rates from travel sites. Offer size varies by property and dates — review the details before you book.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.cheap-stays.com/60-off-hotel-deals.md
- [Cheap Hotels Near You](https://www.cheap-stays.com/cheap-hotels-near-you): Find budget-friendly hotels near your location. We detect your city automatically and show nearby stays — tap to compare on a travel site.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.cheap-stays.com/cheap-hotels-near-you.md
- [Weekend Hotel Deals](https://www.cheap-stays.com/weekend-hotel-deals): Compare weekend hotel deals with Friday–Sunday dates ready. Search any city for a two-night stay and review listed rates before you book.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.cheap-stays.com/weekend-hotel-deals.md
